book.name: Marcos
book.title: Hen anchi ammayay chamag way ensorat Marcos

content: Hen intudtuchun Jesus mepanggép hen hen-ahawa

Angkay hiyachi way lomayaw cha Jesus ad Capernaum, enengwacha hen anchichay fafabréy hen provinsiyan hen Judea yag anchaat gumchang hen anchi wangwang way ekatchéén Jordan. Yag ahchi, cha amoamongan hen anchichay tatagu hiya, yag chana tudtuchuwan chicha te yachi chillu hen chana ekamkaman.

Angkay hiyachi yag émméycha agé hen tapen hen anchichay Fariseo way icha pachasén way manlokop an Jesus. Yag hen henarudhudcha, ekatchéén, “Nokay hen ma-awatam hen orchintaaw, ay wachay karébféngan hen larae way manginhiyan hen ahawana.”
Yag senongfatan Jesus ah harudhud agé, ekatnéén, “Nokay hen inyurchin Moses way ma-ammaan nò.”
Yag ekatchéén, “Emparufusna met te hen ekatna, ‘No ammag omensorat hen larae ah papel ah mangimfaga hen manhiyanancha wat mafalin ihiyanna hen ahawana.’ ”
“Oo a,” way ekat Jesus, “ngém hen nanginyurchinan Moses an nahha, te gapon kenatérén hen uruyu way an-ayug achi matudtuchuwan.
Te hen anchi lugrugin hen egad way hen pés-éy nangammaan Apudyus hen angamin, enammaana hen larae ya fufae.
Yag gapon hiyaha wat taynan hen larae hen chinàcha-arna ta metepon an ahawana.
Wat yachi hen mamfalinéncha ah ihà-anay achar way manepod hen hiyachi, faéncha chuwa te anchag émméhà-an ah matan Apudyus.
Ah Apudyus hen nangamman nadchi, wat maid karébféngan hen tatagu way mangempahiyan hen anchi looh nanteponon Apudyus.”
Angkay hiyachi way hinénggép cha Jesus ah faréy, henanhanan hen anchichay pasorotna no henon laychén hen anchi enalena way aryén.
Yag annaat ekat an chichéén, “Henoy larae way manginhiyan hen ahawana yag kasen nangahawa, fummasor hiya hen anchi pés-éy ahawana te chagchagasna hen anchi inyatobna.
Yag maid agé nat-énana hen fufae way manginhiyan hen ahawana yag kasen nangahawa, te ancha chumagchagas agé.”
Hen namindisyunan Jesus hen anchichay ungunga
Angkay hen-argawan, wachacha hen anchichay cha manginyéy hen ungunga an Jesus ta tad-éna way mamindisyun, ngém chaat agé amhiwén hen anchichay pasorotna chicha.

Yachi way innilan Jesuschi, iningarna hen anchichay pasorotna way mangaliyén, “Masapor eparufusyu hen umaliyan hen ungunga an haén way achiyu cha epawa, te hen anchichay kaman an chicha, wat chichachi hen metape hen mantorayan Apudyus.

Te tot-owa hen antoy ifagà an chàyu way henoy tagu way achi mangempafafa hen acharna ah omafurotana an Apudyus way kaman hen cha ekaman hen antochay ungunga, wat achi angkay mafalin way metape hen mantorayan Apudyus.”
Yachi yag henàlena hen anchichay ungunga yag inchàépna hen limana an chicha way mamindisyun.
Hen anchi tagu way mamatpateg hen kenafaknangna

Angkay hiyachi way cha lumigwat agé cha Jesus, nanagtag hen ihay tagu way i nampalentomang hen henagongna way mangaliyén, “Heay ammay way Apo, nokay hen ammaà ta ma-adchanà ah mannanayun way ataguwan an Apudyus.”
Yag ekat Jesus an hiyéén, “Pakay ekatnowén ammayà, te maid met safalih ammay no faén yanggay ah Apudyus.

Yag innilam chillu hen anchichay orchin Apudyus way achita cha pomatéy ya achita cha chumagchagas, achita cha mangakaw ya achita cha istiguwan hen faén tot-owa, achita lomokop, ya masapor rispituwén hen chinàcha-ar.”
Yag anat ekat hen anchi taguwén, “Oo Apo, tenongpar-o amin chaha nanepod ah kaong-ongà.”

Yag ammag nasékét hen matan Jesus ah layadna an hiya yag ekatnéén, “An ihà-an yanggay hen korang an hea, wat hen ammaam, im elao amin hen anchichay kok-owam yag inidchatno hen laona hen anchichay publi, wat marmu hen tot-oway kafinaknangno ad uchu, yag yachi, an-aat umale way somorot an haén.”
Ngém hen nangngarana hen anchi imfagan Jesus, ammag ngommehpéy hen hamhamàna yag cha lomayaw way chan totokar te ammag faknang way térén.
Angkay lommayaw hen taguwanchi, henagong Jesus hen anchichay pasorotna yag ekatnéén, “Ammag naligat way térén hen metapyan hen faknang hen mantorayan Apudyus.”

Yag anchag nahaang way térén hen anchichay pasorotna hen nangngarancha hen anchi enalena. Ngém entoroy Jesus chillu way mangaliyén, “Sosnod, ammag naligat tot-owa hen ketapyan hen tatagu hen mantorayan Apudyus.
Ngém kaskasen hen anchichay faknang, te ammag narakrakaat hen homroan hen kafayu hen matan hen chagum no hen metapyancha an Apudyus.”
Yag ammag kaskasen hen nahaangan hen anchichay pasorotna, yag anchaat man-ahetoptopà way mangaliyén, “Wat no yaha, ay nanggilah wachay ihà-an lawah mahara-an.”
Finéfétég Jesus chicha way mangaliyén, “No hen tatagu hen mangamma ah kahara-ancha, achi tot-owa mafalin. Ngém no ah Apudyus hen mangamma, wat mafalin te maid achi mafalin an hiya.”
Hiyachi yag anat man-ale ah Pedro way mangaliyén, “Ilam ngén chàni, wat annig tenaynan hen aminay wacha an chàni ah sommorotanni an hea.”

“Tot-owaha,” way ekat Jesus, “yag hen ifagà an chàyu, henoy tagu way manaynan hen fabréyna ya sosnodna ya chinàcha-arna ya hen a-anàna ya hen lotana gapon haén ya hen minwarawagana hen anchi ammayay chamag,

wat midchat agé an hiya hen antoy matatagguwana hen chùchùar no hen tenaynana. Te midchat an hiya hen chùchùar way fumaryana ya hen mansosnodna ya hen manchinàcha-arna ya hen man-a-anàna ya uray agé hen manlotana, ngém yanggay te wacha chillu hen mapap-aligatana. Ngém ah pegwana, mètagu an Apudyus ah ing-inggana.
Ngém hen ihay ifagà agé,” way ekat Jesus, “wat hen anchichay kaman nangato ad uwan, anchag nafafa ah pegwana. Waman hen anchichay kaman nafafa ad uwan, wat chicha agé hen ngomato ah pegwana.”
Hen kasen nangimfag-an Jesus hen matéyana

Angkay hiyachi yag lummigwat cha Jesus way mane-ed hen anchi charan way éméy ad Jerusalem. Cha mamangpango ah Jesus way cha umunud hen anchichay pasorotna way ancha amin ammag nahaang. Yag chacha agé émégyat hen anchichay tapenay tatagu way cha umunud. Yag angkay hiyachi, kasen enet-én Jesus hen anchichay hemporo ya chuway pasorotna, yag kasenna agé imfaga an chicha hen anchi mepasamak an hiya.

Ekatnéén, “Changrényu ngén hen antoy ifagà. Hen antoy ayantaaw ad Jerusalem ad uwan wat haén way Pangorowan hen Tatagu, yato hen kadpapà yag ana-at meporang hen anchichay kangatowan way pachi ya hen anchichay siguchay cha mintudtuchu hen orchin Moses. Yag uwisénà an chicha ah mamchitanà ya ana-at midchat hen anchichay faén Judio.
Yag ana-at agé sénsén-én an chicha ya magénén tenoppaanà ya henapratanà yag ana-at pédtén. Ngém man-uchiyà chillu hen anchi petlon hen ag-agaw.”
Hen chawat cha Jaime an Juan an Jesus
Angkay hiyachi yag hommag-én an Jesus hen anchi chuway a-anà Zebedeo way cha Jaime an Juan way mangaliyén, “Apo, wacha koma hen laychénni way ifaga an hea no mafalin.”
Yag anat ekat Jesusén, “Nokaychi hen laychényu.”
Yag anchaat ekatén, “No umchah hen anchi machachayaw way mantorayam, parufusum koma chàni way mìtùchu an hea way hen iha, ah pachawananno ya hen iha agé, ah pachawigim.”

Ngém ekat Jesus an chichéén, “Maid angkay innilayu hen annay chayu chawatén. Te ay mafalin ma-anohanyu hen ligat way kaman hen anchi ligat way mepachah an haén. Yag ay maetorodyu hen anchi miyatéy way kaman hen anchi iyatéy-o.”
Yag ekatchéén, “Oo, mafalin maetorodni chaha.” Yag ekat Jesusén, “Oo, tot-owa way ma-anohanyu hen ligat way kaman agé hen mepachah an haén, ya etorodyu agé hen miyatéy way kaman hen iyatéy-o.
Ngém hen tumùchu ah pachawanan-o ya ah pachawigì wat faén haén hen mamele, te ah Apudyus hen nangensasagganan cha nadchi way tumùchuwan ah para hen anchichay mangidchatana.”
Angkay hiyachi way chengngar hen anchichay tapenay pasorot Jesus hen anchi cha chawatén hen ifacha way cha Jaime an Juan, ammag lommaweng hen hamhamàcha.

Wat enamong Jesus amin chicha yag ekatna way manugunén, “Innilayu hen cha ekaman hen anchichay chan toray hen antoy lota, te anchag cha manchamancharén hen anchichay chacha etorayan. Ya umat agé hen anchichay o-okom, ancha agég cha manchamancharén hen anchichay ahentagucha.
Ngém achi mafalinha ah ekamanyu. Te chàyu, no heno hen manlayad way man-ap-apo, masapor epafafana hen acharna ah katorongan hen anchichay tapena.
Yag heno agé hen manlayad way ngomato an chàyu, masapor mamfalinéna hen acharna ah kaman alepan hen aminay ifana.

Te uray haén way Pangorowan hen Tatagu wat iggayà ummale hen antoy lota ta mamfalinê hen tatagu ah alepan-o. Te ummaliyà ta an-og mamfalinén hen achar-o ah kaman alepan ah katorongan hen tatagu, ya ta idchat-o agé hen ataguwà ah sobfot hen chuaray tatagu.”
Hen nanga-anan Jesus hen finurag Bartimeo

Angkay hiyachi, inumchah cha Jesus ya hen anchichay pasorotna ad Jerico, yag hen chacha lomayawan, anchag chuar hen anchichay tatagu way cha metnod. Yag wacha hen ihay furag way tummutùchu way chan pap-alemmos hen penget hen chacha charanén. Ah Bartimeo hen ngachanna way anà Timeo.
Yag angkay chengngarna way ah Jesus peet way eNazaret hen naway, inlugina way man-ongaw way mangaliyén, “Jesus way ganà David, panga-asem paat ta ség-anganà.”
Yag chuar hen anchichay cha mangingar an hiya ta guminang koma. Ngém annag inyam-améd way mangèngaw way mangaliyén, “Heay ganà David, panga-asem paat ta ség-anganà.”
Yachi yag entàchég Jesus yag ekatnéén, “Ayaganyu hiyahto.” Wat enayagancha hen anchi furag way mangaliyén, “Wat lomaylayad-a yag tomàchég-a te anchi chacha-a epa-ayag.”
Yag ammag nan-eparàwin Bartimeo hen anchi funnafunna hen tommàchégana way éméy an Jesus.
Yag ekat Jesus an hiyéén, “Nokay hen laychém way ammaà an hea.” Yag ekat anchi nabfuragén, “Apo, ta makailaà koma.”

Yag ekat Jesusén, “Wat in-a ah ayam te gapo hen annay pammatem an haén wat naka-an hen finuragno.” Yag hen hiyachi, naka-anat tot-owa hen anchi finuragna yag netnod an cha Jesus hen anchi chacha ayan.
